test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Raju sold 4 laptops at a rate of ₹1,54,005 all together and incurred a loss of 25%. At what rate should he sell the laptops to gain a profit of 25%?
solution:
**Given:**

Raju sold 4 laptops at a total price of ₹1,54,005 with a loss of 25%.

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = Selling Price (SP) / (1 - Loss%)

New Selling Price to gain 25% profit = CP × (1 + Profit%)

**Calculation:**

Total Selling Price (SP) = ₹1,54,005

Loss% = 25%

Number of laptops = 4

Cost Price (CP) of 4 laptops:

CP = SP / (1 - Loss%)

Loss% = 25% = 25/100 = 0.25

CP = 1,54,005 / (1 - 0.25)

⇒ CP = 1,54,005 / 0.75

⇒ CP = ₹2,05,340

New selling price to gain 25% profit:

Profit% = 25% = 25/100 = 0.25

New SP = CP × (1 + Profit%)

New SP = 2,05,340 × (1 + 0.25)

⇒ New SP = 2,05,340 × 1.25

⇒ New SP = ₹2,56,675

**The correct rate at which he should sell the laptops to gain a profit of 25% is ₹2,56,675.**
